item_short_desc: Let your child's imagination soar with Rothco's Kids Camouflage Helmet. Made of durable plastic, these helmets are perfect for dress-up, pretend play, or completing Halloween costumes. With a camouflage design, they add an authentic touch to any outfit. Measuring approximately 9 inches in diameter x 4.5 inches in height, these helmets are suitable for most children. The included plastic chinstrap ensures a secure fit during playtime adventures.
